approved_payload.content: Police say a 29-year-old man was seriously injured in a confrontation with a group of people near the stadium in the early hours of 4 October, after the Shandesh One Woman Show at the Peter Mokaba rugby field, and was later certified dead in hospital. A friend who arrived to collect him fired one shot from his licensed firearm and the group dispersed; police seized the firearm for ballistic analysis. The case is investigated as murder; no arrests, though police say they have strong leads (police spokesperson Sergeant Maphure Manamela, via Review Online). Police have not confirmed whether this death is connected to the event. The victim is not named here. One report, resting on police: Review Online, 16 October. The pin is approximate: the stadium's map point, not the scene.
